description: The XPeak 2.0 is a newly upgraded version of the trail-ready, all-terrain eBike. Tested to the most aggressive safety standards for off-road eBikes (eMTB), and named by Men's Health as a "Best of Sweat" winner in the 2025 Tech Awards, the XPeak 2.0 now comes standard with an industry-leading torque sensor that provides an exceptional riding experience with intuitive and controlled power delivery at each pedal stroke. Combined with the 750-watt Stealth M24 motor (1310 Peak) for a powerful yet hushed motor experience, the XPeak 2.0 delivers the muscle and speed to take on any terrain as a Class 1, 2, or 3 eBike. Additional upgrades include a newly designed hydroformed frame, a larger 203mm front disc brake rotor for maximum stopping power, an integrated color display, lock-on grips, and an 8-speed Shimano drivetrain.

components.description: The front wheel features a Thru Axle wheel attachment system for a quick and easy installation. This feature ensures a straight wheel, consistent brake rotor alignment, and handling stability. Remove the wheel in minutes for an easy and light-weight transport.
Hydraulic mineral oil brakes paired with a 203mm front rotor and a 180mm rear rotor (1.8mm thick) offer ultimate stopping power and peace of mind in wet or dry conditions.
The XPeak's KMC Z8.1 steel chain is equipped with anti rust protection and offers consistent tension and secure performance throughout your ride.
11-32 tooth, 8-geared freewheel
Forged aluminum, 46-tooth chainring is the perfect ratio for effortless 26-inch wheel pedaling.
Shimano Altus derailleur

A removable 48V, 20Ah (960Wh) lithium-ion battery certified to UL 2271, integrated on the down tube of the frame with a color-matched plate, makes for a clean and easily-accessible design.† The XPeak is also certified to UL 2849.

An auxiliary charging port near the bottom bracket provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. The XPeak comes standard with a 2amp charger for 8-10 hour charging but a 5amp Fast Charger can be purchased separately to speed up charging by 250%.
A backlit color LCD display with a USB-C port provides trip and battery intelligence on the go. IP-65 rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.

A 750W rear hub-motor (1310W Peak) with 85Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before. New Stealth M24 technology is 400% quieter*, delivering a hushed motor experience without sacrificing power.
Adjustable RST Renegade suspension fork with up to 80mm of travel provides shock absorption for a smooth ride.
Ergonomic lock-on grips add comfort so you can ride longer. The plastic sleeve inside helps lock the grips into place and also allows the grips to be easily removed.
A heavy-duty side-sweeping kickstand located near the chain stay keeps the eBike upright.
An integrated safety system, featuring a headlamp and tail light powered by the battery allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Quick-release pedals easily detach from the bike for compact transport.
A custom-designed saddle compliments a sporty look while adding comfort so you can ride longer.
An adjustable and removable seat post allows riders to reach a range of heights while maintaining comfort and stability.

A unique torque sensor combined with PWR+ technology, or Pedal Assist Wattage Regulation+, helps to manage power output based on the rider’s pedaling effort. With this technology, riders can reach higher speeds easily and with more control than ever before.
thumb-triggered handlebar shifter
An ergonomic below-the-bar trigger throttle on the left hand side is easily engaged with your thumb while simultaneously eliminating joint fatigue.
Puncture-resistant 26” x 4” knobby tires can handle any terrain with ease. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires at no additional cost.
A 24 amp controller swiftly distributes power to the motor and is IP-65 rated and potted for weather proofing and thermal management.

Lectric's new Pedal Assist Wattage Regulation+ (PWR+) programming allows for an improved Pedal Assist experience by assisting the rider up to a certain power level for each PAS setting. Learn more about PWR here.
